title: Contract generator: contract JSON, model introspection, AppSync SDL
description:
Implement `design/storage.md` §2.1 as `web/scripts/generate-contract.ts`. Reference for the contract shape: `/Users/home/Projects/Plexus/dashboard/scripts/generate-control-plane-contract.ts` (models, indexes, relationships, authRules, storage).

## Outputs (repo root `contract/`)
- **`apricitus.contract.json`:** per model, `name`; `fields` (name, type, isRequired, isArray, enum or customType); `primaryKey` (identifier fields); `indexes` `[{name, queryField, partitionField, sortFields, sortArgument}]`, including the **implicit hasMany indexes** Amplify creates; `relationships` `[{field, kind: hasMany|belongsTo|hasOne, target, references}]`; `authRules`; `ownerFields`. Top level: `enums`, `customTypes`, `storage.paths`, `version`.
- **`contract.schema.json`:** the JSON Schema for that format. It's **normative**: Virtuus's `virtuus-amplify` vendors it (Virtuus task virt-2e1ef8), so document every field.
- **`model-introspection.json`:** from `@aws-amplify/graphql-generator` `generateModels({ target: 'introspection' })` on the transformed schema.
- **`appsync.graphql`:** the SDL of the generated API (queries, mutations, subscriptions, inputs, connections), from the transform, offline.
- **`schema-version.json`:** the sha256 of each `amplify/{data,auth,storage}/resource.ts` plus the Amplify package versions.

Output must be deterministic: sorted keys, stable order, no timestamps. Validate the contract against the schema with `ajv`. Add npm scripts `contract` (generate) and `contract:check` (exits 1 if regenerating would change any file).

## Verify
```
cd web && npm run contract && npm run contract:check
cd .. && git add -N contract && git diff --stat contract   # inspect
cd web && npm run contract && cd .. && git diff --exit-code contract   # second run: no changes (after staging the first)
```
